rows.en: An android that transformed from a plastic model sent to young Daisaku as a birthday present, part of Dr. Gelma's scheme. It stole Robo's communicator and tried to make it destroy the city. It looks just like young Daisaku, but its eyebrows are slightly thicker. In the original show, it was finally melted with a dissolving fluid made from improved model glue.
A clown robot built by Dr. Komyoji. Believed to hold the secret of a special circuit, it was kidnapped and tortured by Dark.
The survivor of EAGLE's Tohoku branch, which was wiped out by Warrior Mask. He transforms into Aorenger. Good at inventing weapons, he also pilots mecha such as the Variblune, Varidreen and Varitank.
A small two-seat fighter deployed on the space station run by the TDF. It also serves as the first line of defense and can fly inside the atmosphere.

A snow-woman kaiju that freezes opponents by firing freezing gas from its mouth and freezing rays from both hands. Controlled by the Alien Black, it had disguised itself as a snow woman. Height 45 m, weight 23,000 t.

It appears out of black clouds with a clap of thunder. A kaiju like a giant jellyfish, it attacks enemies by emitting high-voltage current from its body. It appears and vanishes at will, and once stole Calamity from the Republic of Merca.
The first head of BF's Japan branch.

A dedicated spacecraft made by fitting a MAT Arrow 1 airframe with booster rockets. Mainly used for maintenance and inspection of the MAT Station. Crew of 2. Length 15 m. In the game it can carry one person besides the pilot.

The form Nobuhiko Akizuki transforms into. He was revived by the three Gorgom Priests' "Stones of Heaven, Earth and Sea". He seeks to defeat Kotaro Minami, a.k.a. "Black Sun", and become Gorgom's complete ruler.

A member of the International Committee for Earth Defense. A scientist who, with Dr. Maeno, pushed ahead with developing the planet-attack super weapon "R1". When Gyeron, with its terrifying regenerative power, attacked Earth, he urged the rushed development and use of "R2". When the doctor joins the TDF science group, the "HP/EN Repair Kit S" and "Special Tab S" become available for development in the game.

The first of Shadow's assassination squad. It appears with a burst of smoke. Number 13 on its back. It fights with the Red-Face Boomerang, launching both of its hands. "You don't stand a chance!" is its catchphrase.

The strongest space dinosaur, brought to Earth by the Alien Zetton. More powerful than Ultraman, it repels everything from the Specium Ray to the Ultra Slash. It fires trillion-degree super-hot fireballs from its mouth and powerful destruction rays from its hands. Height 60 m, weight 30,000 t.

A shape-shifting alien said to have studied Earth for 40 years in order to invade it. It challenges Ultraman with Zetton in tow. It disguised itself as Dr. Iwamoto and tried to destroy Science Patrol headquarters. Height 2 m, weight 60 kg.

Fusion Steel Shell Type E: Zephas. The Fusion Steel shell exclusive to Zephas, whose type name means "Emperor". It has the strongest performance in both attack and defense. Its whole body shines gold, and despite its appearance it moves with agility. Its weapon is the Lucifer Rod, whose converters on both hands it controls freely by wire.

The form in which Zephas's Fusion Steel shell overloaded and completed its fusion with the living metal that had possessed Naager. In this state Zephas becomes a mere "vessel" and completely loses consciousness. In a sense it is a pure metal life form; acting only on its instincts as Number Ten and without hesitation about destruction itself, it becomes a terrifying being.
Besides the Lucifer Rod, its weapon is the compressed graviton shot, which uses Naager's dimensional distortion field to blow enemies away to a galactic core star system far, far away.

A large flying battleship. It attacks with 20 cannons sticking out like a hedgehog's quills and by launching the anchor-shaped weight on its bow. An invasion robot that needs one, and only one, pilot.

A woman in black who plays a central role in the Anti-Shocker League along with Seiichiro Kogure. She entrusts the Rider with transporting an attache case containing data on Gel-Shocker's Great Leader.

The ruler of Gorgom, replaced every 500 years and growing stronger each time. He regarded whichever won between the Century Kings Black Sun and Shadow Moon as the next candidate. He exists only as a giant heart, with enough energy to destroy the Earth.

The Defense Force's finest marksman. Single-minded, but a passionate man with a gentle side too. He has a fiancee named Saeko Nanbu. From Kyushu. In the game too, his Accuracy is head and shoulders above the rest.
Captain of the Space Garrison of the M78 Nebula. He supports the Ultra Brothers fighting on Earth, often flying to Earth to rescue them from danger. His special attack is the M87 Ray.
Combat soldiers who carry out operations under the Mask Monsters. The lowest-ranking cyborgs, they attack enemies in groups. They can transform and also carry out espionage.

The first executive, who came to the Japan branch from Shocker's Middle East branch. He controls the monsters with the whip in his right hand. He does not even tolerate untidy uniforms among his subordinates, and is feared for his extremely cruel nature. He transforms into the Golden Wolf.

The boss of SSI. Gentle by nature and loved by everyone, but a man who will make ruthless decisions when necessary. In the original show, he defeated Fuhrer Deviler and took back Red Baron's secret blueprints, but learning he would be carried off to the Iron Mask Party's space base, he chose to blow himself up. He usually runs a car repair shop.

Leader of the three Gorgom Priests, who carries the "Stone of Heaven" inside his body. Over 800 years old, he is the wisest in Gorgom. He fires a gene-manipulation beam from his right hand and used it to remodel Kotaro Minami. Insidious by nature.

One of the three Gorgom Priests, who carries the "Stone of Sea" inside his body. The most powerful of the three, he fires shock rays from his fingertips and can raise a barrier in front of his body. Cruel and belligerent by nature.

One of the three Gorgom Priests, who carries the "Stone of Earth" inside her body. A prophet who can see the future with her right eye and the past with her left. She fires scorching balls of light from both eyes. She shows no mercy to enemies.

A super life form that rules the Fushigi World Fuuma and plots to rule the whole universe. It lays Fushigi Beast eggs from its mouth. 12,000 years ago its head was cut off by the hero Shaider, and it had been secretly building a mechanical body.

It extends from its head a Diamond Cutter that slices even steel and Kirenger's face, and fires from its eyes a Diamond Ray that melts even safe dials. On General Magman's orders, it stole the secret blueprints of the Gorenger suits from the Science Weapons Research Institute.

She approached Jiro intending to kill him, but failed. She was actually a temporary form taken by Violet Sazae of Dark's destruction unit. In the game she does not transform, and blows herself up with a charm containing a bomb.
Takeshi Hongo's fellow racer and an FBI special investigator. He fights Shocker and Gel-Shocker together with Hongo and Ichimonji.

Staff officer at the TDF Far East Base, who also commands the Ultra Garrison. His calm judgment often leads incidents to resolution, and he frequently takes personal command of the Garrison in the field. He was once in charge of the nuclear ship Max.
An inspector sent by the Crisis Emperor, under his direct command. He reports each operational failure of General Jark and the four battalion commanders to the emperor. A skilled swordsman.

He runs the Tachibana Racing Club and is also the master of the snack bar "Amigo". He knows about Shocker and understands the situation of Riders such as Hongo and Ichimonji. He also helped develop the "New Cyclone". In the game, the Amigo becomes the heroes' hangout.

Inventor of the transparent metal QQV. In the game he is an authority on functional alloys, and joining the TDF science group makes the "High Defender S" and "High Defender L" available for development.

An all-purpose sidecar that can operate not only on land but underwater, underground and in space. In the air in particular it can fly at 800 km/h. It carries one missile launcher on each side of the body. Top speed on land is 500 km/h.
They attack with swords and shields and can disguise themselves as humans. Highly intelligent, they command the Beast Monsters. They later merge with Beast Monsters to become Double Monsters.
He was taken into the Brain Party together with Captain Gomez. He supports Gomez as his trusty right hand. A master of knife throwing and disguise.

A heavy attack aircraft dedicated to fighting kaiju and robots, which becomes available for development when Science Patrol member Ide joins through a job change. It fires reusable ultra-hard drills made of a new alloy from the airframe, dealing mechanical blows to giant kaiju and robots. Crew of 1, length 30.74 m, top speed Mach 3.2.
